entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Banji, learned counsel for the petitioner.

2. Instant revision is filed by the petitioner challenging the impugned order dated 21st September,
2025 passed in connection with C.T. Case No.27 of 2023 by the learned Additional District &
Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Bargarh on the grounds stated.
3.
The petitioner moved an application under Section 227 Cr.P.C. seeking discharge, however, the same has been rejected vide Annexure-4.

4. Mr. Banji, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that no case under Section 376 I.P.C read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act is made out, since, the relationship between the parties had been consensual.

5. To consider and appreciate the plea of the petitioner, the Court is inclined to direct the State to respond with a notice to the informant/victim, namely, opposite party No.2.
6.
Hence, it is ordered.

7. Notice.
8.
Mr. Sahoo, learned ASC for the State accepts notice for opposite party No.1.

Notice to opposite party No.2 by Speed Post with a short returnable date and for the said purpose, requisites shall be filed by Mr. Banji, learned counsel for the petitioner within seven days from today.
9. List on 13th January, 2026 for final hearing and orders.

3. 4.
List on the date fixed for further orders.
5. Urgent copy of this order be issued as per rules.
